title: Visiting Professor of Law
bio: Professor Yas Banifatemi is an Adjunct Professor of law at the University of Panthéon-Sorbonne in Paris, where she has taught international arbitration since 2006. Her affiliation with Harvard Law School started in 2018, when she introduced Investment Treaty Arbitration into the curriculum, co-teaching with the late Professor Emmanuel Gaillard.
